name: zcode-bilingual
description: Hover ZCode UI text to see a translation tooltip: English UI shows Chinese, Chinese UI shows English. The original text and the layout are never modified. Catalog-driven surfaces are covered automatically; plugin/skill/subagent/MCP metadata is covered by an extensible dictionary.json. Self-healing: a ZCode update that wipes the patch is detected and repaired automatically.

description_i18n.en: Hover ZCode UI text to see a translation tooltip: English UI shows Chinese, Chinese UI shows English. The original text and the layout are never modified. Catalog-driven surfaces are covered automatically; plugin/skill/subagent/MCP metadata is covered by an extensible dictionary.json.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 鼠标悬停在 ZCode 界面文案上时浮出另一种语言的翻译气泡：英文界面显示中文，中文界面显示英文。原有文字与排版完全不动。客户端文案目录自动覆盖；插件/技能/子智能体/MCP 的动态文字由可扩展的 dictionary.json 覆盖。
